formula.body:
# Osmanthus Apricot-Suede Chypre — 30mL EdP

## Character
A warm vintage chypre anchored by osmanthus absolute — apricot-lactonic fruit meets suede leather over classic oakmoss-patchouli bones. The osmanthus bridges the fruity top and leathery base naturally, avoiding the synthetic apricot-suede of pure aromachemicals. Think Mitsouko reimagined with an osmanthus heart.

**Family**: Chypre (classic) — bergamot top, oakmoss-patchouli base, floral-fruity heart

## Accords

| Accord | Role | Materials |
|--------|------|-----------|
| **Osmanthus core** | Natural character anchor | Osmanthus Absolute, Apritone, Gamma Decalactone, Damascone Beta |
| **Chypre skeleton** | Structural frame | Bergamot FCF, Oakmoss Absolute, Patchouli EO, Evernyl, Labdanum |
| **Suede layer** | Leather texture | Suederal, IBQ (trace) |
| **Violet bridge** | Heart connector | Beta Ionone, Alpha Ionone, Methyl Ionone Pure |
| **Fixative gradient** | Diffusion + longevity | Benzyl Salicylate (heavy), Hexyl Salicylate (light), Benzyl Benzoate (inert) |
| **Musk chord** | 3-axis musk | Ethylene Brassylate (depth), Romandolide (projection), Habanolide (skin-warmth) |
| **Radiance** | Volume expansion | Hedione, Iso E Super, Vertofix |

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) | Amount (mL) |
|---|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| **🌅 Top** |

| **💕 Heart** |

| 8 | Hedione HC | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 9 | Damascone Beta | 10% | 60 | 0.060 |
| 10 | Apritone | 10% | 180 | 0.180 |
| 11 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 50 | 0.050 |

| 13 | Alpha Ionone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 14 | Alpha Isomethyl Ionone | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 15 | Linalyl Acetate | neat | 100 | 0.100 |
| 16 | Dihydrojasmone | neat | 40 | 0.040 |
| 17 | Phenethyl Alcohol | neat | 100 | 0.100 |
| 18 | Rhodinol ex Citronella | neat | 30 | 0.030 |
| **🪵 Base** |
| 19 | Iso E Super | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 20 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 450 | 0.450 |
| 21 | Hexyl Salicylate | neat | 180 | 0.180 |
| 22 | Benzyl Benzoate | neat | 180 | 0.180 |
| 23 | Oakmoss Absolute | 10% in DPG | 200 | 0.200 |
| 24 | Patchouli EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 25 | Evernyl | 50% in DPG | 30 | 0.030 |
| 26 | Labdanum Resinoid | 10% in DPG | 100 | 0.100 |
| 27 | Suederal | 10% | 80 | 0.080 |

| 32 | Ambrettolide | 10% in DPG | 60 | 0.060 |

| 34 | Cedarwood EO | neat | 100 | 0.100 |

| 36 | Timberol | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 37 | Ambrofix | 30% w/v | 80 | 0.080 |

**Concentrate total**: 5,328 µL (17.8% of 30mL)

## Musk Chord (3-axis)

| Axis | Material | Dose (µL) | Function |
|------|----------|-----------|----------|
| Depth | Ethylene Brassylate | 120 neat | Lactonic skin-sit |
| Projection | Romandolide | 80 neat | Diffusive outward projection |
| Character-echo | Habanolide + Ambrettolide | 60 + 60 | Warm-skin intimacy + naturalistic fruity-musky |

## Fixative Gradient

| Layer | Material | Dose | VP |
|-------|----------|------|-----|
| Heavy | Benzyl Salicylate | 450 neat | 0.01 Pa |
| Light | Hexyl Salicylate | 180 neat | 0.03 Pa |
| Inert | Benzyl Benzoate | 180 neat | 0.02 Pa |

## Material Justification

- **Osmanthus Absolute**: The natural anchor — apricot-leather-tea character that bridges fruity top to leathery base. At 600 µL of 10% = 60 µL active, it's dominant enough to define the scent without drowning the chypre skeleton.
- **Suederal (10%) + IBQ (10%)**: Suede leather at trace — osmanthus already carries a leather facet, these amplify it without adding smoke. IBQ at 2.5 µL active prevents the suede from reading as "clean laundry."
- **Oakmoss Absolute (10%) + Evernyl + Patchouli**: Classic chypre trinity — oakmoss provides the bitter-green lichen character (20 µL active), Evernyl adds synthetic body, Patchouli anchors the earth.
- **Apritone + Damascone Beta + Gamma Decalactone**: The apricot-peach axis that mirrors osmanthus's natural lactonic character. Apritone at 18 µL active is the primary apricot carrier.
- **Beta Ionone + Alpha Ionone + Methyl Ionone Pure**: Violet-powder bridge between the fruity heart and woody base — prevents the apricot-to-oakmoss transition from being jarring.
- **Labdanum Resinoid (10%)**: Amber-resin warmth at 15 µL active — the chypre's warm undercurrent, balances the bitter oakmoss.
- **Hedione HC**: Radiance amplifier at 500 µL — expands the osmanthus and ionones outward. High-cis chosen over standard for more floral lift.
- **Ethylene Brassylate**: Creamy depth musk — sits on skin. Pairs with the lactonic apricot character.
- **Romandolide**: Chosen over Galaxolide for projection musk — cleaner and more diffusive, keeps the chypre from reading too vintage/dated.
- **Timberol**: Architectural cedar — adds structural rigidity to the woody base without the pencil-shaving note of Cedarwood EO alone.
